$comment: Schema used to generate data/wallet_seed.json with an LLM (see docs/AGENT.md → Disclosure). All money is integer Iraqi dinars (IQD). Timestamps in the seed are relative (days_ago) so the history always looks recent.

settings.transfer_fee: integer IQD, flat fee per transfer
settings.daily_limit: integer IQD, sum of outgoing money per user per day

contacts.name: string, as saved in the phonebook; duplicates and near-duplicates are intentional
contacts.relation: string|null — how the owner refers to them: اخوي, امي, صديق, جار ...
contacts.wallet_user_id: users.id|null — null means this contact has no wallet (transfers must fail)

bill_accounts.label: string — how the user names it: البيت, المحل ...
bill_accounts.due_amount: integer IQD currently owed (0 = nothing to pay)

transactions.counterparty_ref: string — contact phone or bill account id
transactions.days_ago: integer — converted to a timestamp at load time
